collection.title: Ford Focus Hatchback 2018 to 2026 windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: The Ford Focus Hatchback Mk4 2018 Onwards version requires a 24" Drivers side and a 20" Passengers side wiper blades and all of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle. This model uses the Push Button arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also offer a choice of rear screen wipers for this Focus which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
